decisions.reason: The colour impact is already fully represented by the candidate's message-30 MODIFY, including removal of the obsolete overall colour direction.
The strapline colour decision does not alter the letterform requirement; its same-message change comes from the separate request to add character to more letters.
Matching the strapline colour to GLOBAL does not change the flame-based O or its recognition requirement.
The source changes the strapline's colour presentation but leaves the requirement to include the existing strapline unchanged.
The candidate's same-message visual-character attributes arise from the separate font and letterform request, not from the strapline colour change.
Selecting the graduated strapline colour treatment does not change the concept-development process or the role of reference material.
The source does not change the company name, excluded wording, or broader-business representation.
The strapline colour selection does not affect the requirement for fresh original artwork or the inspiration-only role of the AI-generated draft.
The source selects a logo colour treatment but does not change the independent obligation to provide brand colour documentation.
Neither the strapline colour decision nor the separate letterform request changes the obligation to supply complementary brand font guidance.
